case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr. Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your cost drivers. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and would like to find a fair solution for both sides.

Our data shows a slightly different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

With this in mind, we have put together options built around a longer partnership. Each one gives you planning security, and the options with longer payment terms are meant to be a fair exchange for the lower price:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.41; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.51; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

We would be glad to settle this together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. We value our long-standing cooperation, but our pricing must reflect the current cost environment and operational realities.

We are pleased to submit our offer featuring a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative option, we can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract with 30-day payment terms at a unit price of €4.88, specifically structured as a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer represents the maximum flexibility we can provide at this time and remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr. Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking another look at our delivery data. We appreciate your openness, and we value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies.

We would like to find a fair solution for both sides. Each option below is built on a longer partnership and gives you planning security. The options with a longer payment term or a shorter one answer different preferences, so you can choose what suits you best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.46; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.56; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months.

We hope one of these lets us renew our agreement together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always strive to provide you with top-tier service and access to our extensive inventory.

We have reviewed your revised options, but we cannot accommodate any further price reductions. Our previously stated price of €4.88 for a 36-month contract with 30-day payment terms represents our absolute limit. Consequently, we must present this as our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
